payload.summary: Owner decision: TGA/SaMD classification for the MHA quoted timeline, the app's first surface that computes a statutory deadline
payload.detail: The timeline on form pages turns a trigger time plus a statutory duration into a Perth deadline, but only for owner-signed entries (quote-only otherwise; three s 28 Form 3A limits permanently quote-only). docs/samd-classification-medication-considerations.md is open and covers a different surface. Next action: owner either extends that note to cover the timeline or records a short ruling that it sits outside its scope. Until then, do not sign off timeframes whose computed time would be relied on.
